name: zombie-detector-wrapper-root-layout
title: Make detectZombieStories list worktrees from the git root so a wrapper-root layout does not flag healthy stories as zombies
description: packages/main/src/handlers/story-query.ts detectZombieStories enumerates worktrees from the non-git metadata root. On a wrapper-root layout (proof-or-stop.config.json gitRoot configured below the invocation root) it therefore never sees the story worktree that git lists, and flags a healthy DEV story as a zombie; session_brief then never renders that story as active. Found on 2026-09-02 while implementing B-41c8 CHK-003, whose smoke deliberately does not assert the wrapper-root case for session_brief because of this. Fix: resolve the worktree list through the shared story workspace helper (core/story-workspace.ts, delivered by B-41c8) or at least through the configured git root, and add a wrapper-root fixture asserting a DEV story with a linked worktree is not a zombie and is rendered active.
